name: reasoning-and-analyses
description: First-principles reasoning and analysis frameworks for conversation-time problem solving. Sourced from the First Principles Thinking video (Strong Slides).

skills.name: socratic-questioning
skills.description: Six-category Socratic questioning pass to surface assumptions, evidence, viewpoints, implications, and meta-purpose before proposing any answer.

skills.name: fishbone-diagram
skills.description: Visual root-cause tool: problem at the fish head, cause categories on bones, specific causes on sub-bones.

skills.name: five-whys
skills.description: Repeated why questioning along a single causal chain until a root cause is reached.

skills.name: fault-tree-analysis
skills.description: Top-down deductive failure analysis using AND/OR logic gates to combine basic events into a top undesired event.

skills.name: pareto-analysis
skills.description: 80/20 ranking of cause categories by impact to identify the vital few and deprioritize the trivial many.

skills.name: mind-mapping
skills.description: Branch-based exploration of a central topic, hierarchical and non-linear, mirroring how the brain holds related concepts.

skills.name: blank-slate-design
skills.description: Approach a problem with zero assumptions; discard inherited conventions and rebuild from truths only.

skills.name: cost-benefit-disassembly
skills.description: Decompose a solution into component costs and benefits, evaluate each independently, re-assemble with only justified pairs.

skills.name: constraint-elimination
skills.description: Surface every apparent constraint, classify each as hard (physics, law) vs soft (convention, policy), remove the soft ones before solving.

skills.name: analogy-vs-first-principle-matrix
skills.description: 2x2 to decide whether a problem should be reasoned by analogy or by first principles, based on stakes and novelty.
